items.title: Functions of OSI Model Layers (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Functions of OSI Model Layers' (PDF 13-14): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: Data communication mein har OSI layer ka khaas role (kirdar) hai. Physical layer raw (kacha) data signals ki shakal mein bhejti hai. Data link layer error-free (baghair ghalti ke) transfer control karti hai. Network layer data ki routing (raasta chunna) karti hai. Transport layer reliable (bharose wali) delivery yaqeeni banati hai. Session, presentation aur application layers user interaction (user ke saath kaam) aur data formatting (data ko sahi shakal dena) mein madad deti hain.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Neechli layers data ki physical transfer (ek jagah se doosri jagah bhejna) sambhalti hain. Darmiyani layers routing aur delivery sambhalti hain. Oopri layers user ki applications ko support karti hain. Har layer alag (independently) kaam karti hai. Mil kar yeh sahi baat-cheet yaqeeni banati hain.
Data communication mein har OSI layer ka khaas kaam hai:

items: Physical Layer: kacha (raw) data bijli, roshni (optical) ya radio signals ki shakal mein medium (taar ya hawa) par bhejti hai. Yeh hardware ki baatein tay karti hai, jaise cables, connectors, voltage levels aur data bhejne ki raftar.

Data Link Layer: seedhe jure hue nodes (devices) ke darmiyan data be-ghalti pohanchati hai. Yeh framing (data ko frames mein band karna), ghalti pakarna aur theek karna, aur mushtarka (shared) medium tak access (pohanch) control karti hai.

Network Layer: data ko mukhtalif networks se guzar kar source (bhejne wale) se destination (manzil) tak pohanchane (routing) ki zimmedar hai. Yeh logical addressing (IP addresses) sambhalti aur data ke liye behtareen raasta chunti hai.

Transport Layer: devices ke darmiyan data qabil-e-bharosa aur sahi tarteeb se pohanchati hai. Yeh ghalti ke baad bahali (error recovery), flow control (bahao ki raftar ka control) aur data ko chhote hisson (segments) mein baantne ka kaam karti hai.
Session Layer: applications ke darmiyan baat-cheet ke sessions shuru karti, qaim rakhti aur khatam karti hai. Yeh session checkpoints aur rukawat ki soorat mein bahali sambhalti hai.
Presentation Layer: data ko aisi shakal mein badalti hai jo application layer samajh sake. Yeh encryption (khufia banana), compression (chhota karna) aur format ki tabdeeli karti hai.
Application Layer: users aur applications ko seedhi services deti hai. Yeh HTTP, FTP aur email jaise protocols ko baat-cheet aur data ke len-den ke liye support karti hai.

blocks.prompt: OSI ki saat layers neeche se oopar tak batayein, aur batayein ke IP addresses aur routing kaun si layer sambhalti hai.
blocks.explanation: Physical, Data Link, Network, Transport, Session, Presentation, Application. IP addresses aur routing Network layer sambhalti hai.

blocks.prompt: Encryption aur compression kaun si layer karti hai, aur data ko segments mein kaun si baant'ti hai?
blocks.explanation: Encryption aur compression: Presentation layer. Segments: Transport layer.

items: Neeche: Physical (signals, cables), Data Link (be-ghalti frames).
Beech: Network (IP addresses, routing), Transport (bharose wali, tarteeb wali delivery).
Oopar: Session (sessions), Presentation (format, encryption, compression), Application (HTTP, FTP, email).
